'''Lyn''' (Japanese: '''リム''' ''Rimu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY016|A Jolting Switcheroo!]]''.

She and her older sister [[Lena]] were resting at the same [[Pokémon Center]] as {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Unbeknownst to any of them, Lyn's near-identical bag, which contained a {{p|Pichu}} she had been caring for, was accidentally switched with {{an|Bonnie}}'s bag, which contained {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}. As she and Lena left and were walking down the street, Lyn noticed Dedenne was in her bag instead of Pichu. Worried, she quickly ran off to find Pichu while Lena was busy talking to a friend.

While she was still worried about Pichu, Lyn decided to care for Dedenne by giving him food and tying a ribbon on his ear. Lyn decided to go back to the Pokémon Center to find out more information about where Pichu went. She couldn't find the Pokémon Center, however, and she found out Dedenne had run off. She found him sleeping in a store with stuffed [[Pokémon doll]]s. Continuing their search for Pichu and Bonnie, Dedenne suddenly noticed an array of electric waves in the air, created by one of {{an|Clemont}}'s [[Clemontic Gear|inventions]] in an attempt to lure Dedenne to him and his group. Attracted by it, Dedenne ran off once again, in the direction of the waves' origin.

On the way, Dedenne passed through a vineyard to eat some grapes, but he was attacked by a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Beedrill}}. Initially disposing of it with {{m|Thunder Shock}}, the Beedrill angrily returned with a whole swarm of Beedrill. As Lyn and Dedenne ran away, Lyn tripped and was about to attacked by the Beedrill. Just then, she and Dedenne were saved by [[Ash's Pikachu]], as Ash, his friends, Lena, and Pichu had found Lyn. Lyn was reunited with Pichu, while Bonnie reunited with Dedenne. Afterwards, both girls burst out into tears and apologized for causing the whole incident. Then, the entire group decided to have dinner together. Clemont and Lena noticed that Pichu and Dedenne weren't eating, and quickly realized Bonnie and Lyn had been overfeeding the Pokémon with snacks.

While resting at a [[Pokémon Center]], Lyn's bag, which contained Pichu, was accidentally switched with {{an|Bonnie}}'s bag, which contained {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}. Bonnie realized this while watching a battle between {{Ash}} and {{an|Clemont}}. Startled and confused, Pichu started to attack its surroundings. [[Ash's Pikachu]] managed to calm it down by shocking it with {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Ash and {{ashfr}}  decided to go look for Pichu's original Trainer and Dedenne.

As the group gradually got information about Dedenne's whereabouts and Pichu's Trainer, Bonnie and Pikachu decided to care for Pichu for the time being, by giving it food and playing with it. Clemont came up with the idea to use one of his inventions to lure Dedenne to them. The invention eventually exploded, and this was noticed by Lena, who quickly rushed to the scene, as she in turn was looking for Lyn. Lena was happy to find Pichu with the group and joined them in their quest to find Lyn and Dedenne. They eventually found them in a vineyard, about to be attacked by a horde of wild {{p|Beedrill}}. Pikachu drove the Beedrill away with Thunderbolt and Pichu reunited with Lyn.

Pichu's only known move is {{m|Thunder Shock}}.}}
